summary: Interim assay worksheet for the BP16 CYP interaction confirmation on the Belquorin oxazole carboxamide set. Screening runs are complete; the tables show the currently recorded subset of results. Final concentration-response interpretation awaits client identity confirmation for a relabelled vial, so no progression call is made.
